{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Cache.Client where

import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as B
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Base16 as B16
import Crypto.Random (getRandomBytes)
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)

type SessionId = ByteString
type NodeId = ByteString

data RateLimitState = RateLimitState
  { rlTokens :: !Int
  , rlLastRefill :: !POSIXTime
  , rlMaxTokens :: !Int
  , rlRefillRate :: !Int
  } deriving (Show)

data CacheSession = CacheSession
  { csSessionId :: !SessionId
  , csNodeId :: !NodeId
  , csCreatedAt :: !POSIXTime
  , csLastAccess :: !POSIXTime
  , csRetryCount :: !Int
  , csAuthenticated :: !Bool
  } deriving (Show)

data CacheClient = CacheClient
  { ccSessions :: !(MVar (Map.Map SessionId CacheSession))
  , ccRateLimits :: !(IORef (Map.Map NodeId RateLimitState))
  , ccMaxRetries :: !Int
  , ccSessionTimeout :: !NominalDiffTime
  }

newCacheClient :: Int -> NominalDiffTime -> IO CacheClient
newCacheClient maxRetries timeout = do
  sessions <- newMVar Map.empty
  rateLimits <- newIORef Map.empty
  return $ CacheClient sessions rateLimits maxRetries timeout

-- | Generate a cryptographically secure, unpredictable session identifier.
-- Uses a CSPRNG (getRandomBytes) rather than a weak PRNG, and hex-encodes
-- 32 random bytes (256 bits of entropy).
generateSessionId :: IO SessionId
generateSessionId = do
  raw <- getRandomBytes 32 :: IO ByteString
  return $ B16.encode raw

checkRateLimit :: CacheClient -> NodeId -> IO Bool
checkRateLimit client nodeId = do
  now <- getPOSIXTime
  limits <- readIORef (ccRateLimits client)
  let state = fromMaybe (RateLimitState 10 now 10 2) (Map.lookup nodeId limits)
  let elapsed = now - rlLastRefill state
      newTokens = min (rlMaxTokens state) $
                    rlTokens state + floor (elapsed * fromIntegral (rlRefillRate state))
  if newTokens > 0
    then do
      let updated = state { rlTokens = newTokens - 1, rlLastRefill = now }
      writeIORef (ccRateLimits client) (Map.insert nodeId updated limits)
      return True
    else return False

-- | Initiate a new session or reconnect to existing one.
-- When a client provides a sessionId hint, we attempt session resumption
-- to avoid re-authentication overhead on transient network failures.
connectWithRetry :: CacheClient -> NodeId -> Maybe SessionId -> Int -> IO (Either String CacheSession)
connectWithRetry client nodeId mSessionHint attempt = do
  allowed <- checkRateLimit client nodeId
  unless allowed $ error "Rate limited"
  now <- getPOSIXTime
  sessions <- takeMVar (ccSessions client)
  result <- case mSessionHint of
    Just hintId -> do
      -- Session resumption path: validate ownership before reuse
      case Map.lookup hintId sessions of
        Just existing
          | csNodeId existing == nodeId -> do
              -- Only allow resumption by the same node that created it
              -- and always reset authentication state on reconnect
              let resumed = existing
                    { csLastAccess = now
                    , csRetryCount = attempt
                    , csAuthenticated = False
                    }
              putMVar (ccSessions client) (Map.insert hintId resumed sessions)
              return $ Right resumed
          | otherwise -> do
              -- Different node trying to resume - reject and create fresh
              newId <- generateSessionId
              let newSession = CacheSession newId nodeId now now attempt False
              putMVar (ccSessions client) (Map.insert newId newSession sessions)
              return $ Right newSession
        Nothing -> do
          -- Hint refers to expired/unknown session, create new
          newId <- generateSessionId
          let newSession = CacheSession newId nodeId now now attempt False
          putMVar (ccSessions client) (Map.insert newId newSession sessions)
          return $ Right newSession
    Nothing -> do
      newId <- generateSessionId
      let newSession = CacheSession newId nodeId now now attempt False
      putMVar (ccSessions client) (Map.insert newId newSession sessions)
      return $ Right newSession
  case result of
    Left err | attempt < ccMaxRetries client ->
      connectWithRetry client nodeId mSessionHint (attempt + 1)
    _ -> return result

authenticateSession :: CacheClient -> SessionId -> ByteString -> IO Bool
authenticateSession client sid credential = do
  sessions <- takeMVar (ccSessions client)
  case Map.lookup sid sessions of
    Just session -> do
      let valid = validateCredential credential
      let updated = session { csAuthenticated = valid }
      putMVar (ccSessions client) (Map.insert sid updated sessions)
      return valid
    Nothing -> do
      putMVar (ccSessions client) sessions
      return False

validateCredential :: ByteString -> Bool
validateCredential cred = BS.length cred >= 8 && BS.any (\c -> c >= '0' && c <= '9') cred

-- | Execute a cache operation, requires authenticated session
cacheGet :: CacheClient -> SessionId -> ByteString -> IO (Either String ByteString)
cacheGet client sid key = do
  sessions <- readMVar (ccSessions client)
  case Map.lookup sid sessions of
    Just session
      | csAuthenticated session -> return $ Right $ BS.append "value:" key
      | otherwise -> return $ Left "Session not authenticated"
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Invalid session"

-- | Invalidate a session
disconnect :: CacheClient -> SessionId -> IO ()
disconnect client sid = do
  sessions <- takeMVar (ccSessions client)
  putMVar (ccSessions client) (Map.delete sid sessions)
